about: Map layers the Strom app may draw over a house's place (GET /status houses.layers, spec 030 part 2): only open services whose host is in archives.json as allowed for automated use, outside its disallowed paths (test/unit/maplayers.test.ts). A layer is offered to a research only when its bbox [west, south, east, north] holds a place of a house of the tree. kind: as a house's maps[] item names it (core/model.ts HOUSE_MAP_KINDS). checked: the day its GetCapabilities was read.
